title: Install
description: Canon runs as a Node.js 22+ command-line tool straight from its Git repository, with no cloud account, no database and no runtime dependencies.

text: The builder, verifier and server use only the Node.js standard library — nothing else is installed at runtime.
brings in dev-only tooling (tests, the browser checker, the Markdown parser used by the test suite); it is never required to build, verify, publish or serve a packet.

blocks.source:
git clone https://github.com/oncanon/canon.git
cd canon
npm ci --offline   # dev tooling only; safe to skip if you trust node_modules already present
node src/cli.mjs   # prints usage
